title: INDIA Bloc Bengaluru Stir: Protesters Target CEC Gyanesh Kumar Over SIR

ai.summary: Protesters in Bengaluru targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter recheck, demanding removal of deleted voters from electoral rolls.

facts.claim: Protesters in Bengaluru targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter recheck
facts.quote: Leaders and supporters of the INDIA bloc staged a large-scale demonstration at Freedom Park in Bengaluru to register their opposition against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise.

facts.claim: demanding removal of deleted voters from electoral rolls
facts.quote: The agitation condemned the ongoing SIR process and called for rolling back all deleted voters from the electoral rolls, excluding deceased individuals, asserting that the fight will continue until full justice is served.

ai.background_note: The protest is part of the broader BLO (Booth-level officers) movement against the SIR voter recheck process, which has been criticized for workload and deadlines.
